name: IC — MLF
description: Surface-mount IC cluster utilizing MLF package footprints with exposed pads and optional thermal vias across 6, 8, and 20-pin configurations.
selection_hints: Select when needing surface-mount ICs in MLF packages with exposed pads.
Match target footprint dimensions such as 1.6x1.6mm, 3x3mm, or 4x4mm.
Choose footprints with thermal vias when added thermal dissipation is required.
Check part tier status (1 Tier B, 4 Tier C) and source library before selection.
avoid_when: The layout requires through-hole or non-MLF package footprints.
Pin count or pitch differs from the available 6, 8, or 20-pin MLF options.
Only Tier A verified component entries are accepted.
